styles.name: 博物写实
styles.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create one polished landscape canine encyclopedia illustration STYLE SAMPLE BOARD for the mobile app CanisXuan. This is ORIGINAL DRAWN ART, not photography. A precise 3 columns by 2 rows grid of SIX isolated full-body adult dogs on one clean pure white background. No borders, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no people, no props or landscape. Equal cell sizes, ample clear space around every dog, all four paws and entire tail visible. All six dogs stand naturally, facing viewer's right in a slightly three-quarter side view, at the same relative scale WITHIN their species; actual adult breed proportions, never oversized cartoon heads or baby proportions. Left column in both rows: Bichon Frise, compact small adult dog, WHITE curly coat, dark round eyes, black nose, plumed tail carried over back, drooping ears covered in curls. Top left has classic rounded fluffy pet grooming. Bottom left is the SAME breed with a shorter practical pet trim, visibly curly, a grooming variation, still white. Do not depict a poodle, Maltese or toy bear. Top middle: classic BLACK AND WHITE rough-coated adult BORDER COLLIE, athletic medium-sized body, moderately long muzzle, semi-erect ears with folded tips, black back with balanced white facial blaze and chest, white feet, long low-carried feathery tail. Bottom middle: BLACK AND WHITE SMOOTH-COATED border collie of the same adult proportions, shorter coat distinctly visible, not a different breed. Top right: CHOCOLATE/BROWN AND WHITE rough-coated border collie, correct collie head and athletic proportions. Bottom right: BLUE MERLE rough-coated border collie, mottled light grey coat with irregular black patches, white blaze/chest/feet, no blue fur. All border collies have natural brown eyes, never curled spitz tails. Breed identification and differences between coat colors, coat length and grooming are crucial. Preserve this exact six-cell content and arrangement.
Style A: contemporary natural-history field-guide painting. Precise, beautifully observed canine anatomy, hand-painted gouache and fine colored-pencil detailing, subtle visible brush and pencil marks, delicate individual fur curls and strands, realistic but unmistakably illustrated. Refined muted natural coat colors and extremely restrained warm-grey contact shadows. Museum-quality zoological plate, clear silhouettes, no retro brown paper or yellowing, no photographic cutouts, no fantasy. Make it feel like an excellent artist carefully painted a modern breed atlas.
